guides.definition: Adds the Tailwind CSS v4 import to an application stylesheet. Editor/build-tool content: configure Tailwind CSS 4 in the target project; Hypershell does not run the Tailwind compiler.

examples.title: Import Tailwind
examples.explanation: Tailwind v4 discovers source classes automatically in common setups; configure explicit sources when project structure requires them.

guides.definition: Adds a Tailwind v4 theme variable that generates matching utility classes. Editor/build-tool content: configure Tailwind CSS 4 in the target project; Hypershell does not run the Tailwind compiler.

parameters.name: tokenNamespace
parameters.description: Namespace such as color, font, or spacing.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Valid CSS value for the token.

examples.title: Define a brand color
examples.explanation: Theme namespaces connect design tokens to generated utilities; use a stable naming convention shared with the design system.

guides.definition: Creates a Tailwind v4 utility backed by ordinary CSS declarations. Editor/build-tool content: configure Tailwind CSS 4 in the target project; Hypershell does not run the Tailwind compiler.

parameters.name: utilityName
parameters.description: Class name without the leading dot.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: CSS property set by the utility.

examples.title: Add a balanced text utility
examples.explanation: @utility registers a class that participates in Tailwind variants and build-time usage detection.
